mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(productIdx, title, content, price, userIdx, tradeType, tradePlace, regionIdx, productStatus, categoryIdx) VALUES(seq_product.NEXTVAL, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, 1, #{tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradePlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, #{productStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT productIdx, title, content, price, userIdx, hitCount, likeCount, chatCount, tradeType, tradeStatus, tradePlace, regionIdx, productStatus, pullCount, lastUpDate, createdDate, updatedDate, categoryIdx FROM product WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
SELECT imgOrder, productIdx, imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY imgOrder ASC
SELECT t.tagName FROM productTag p JOIN tag t ON p.tagIdx = t.tagIdx WHERE p.productIdx = #{productIdx}
